system.description:
A travelling entertainer with no school or patron.

  • Showmanship: Advantage on Charisma checks to hold an audience while maintaining an illusion. Once per encounter, as your reaction when an attack you can see hits you, it struck a stage-trick double instead: it misses.
  • New Face, New Town: Advantage on all checks to establish a false identity in a new town, and on Legend Lore about travelling performers and carnivals.
